$comment: Study-area TIPLOCs (project scope, described from Network Rail CORPUS) and their links to infrastructure. TIPLOCs are never guessed; unmapped ones need a sourced position.

provenance.note: Joined on CRS SHR: CORPUS gives SHRWBY -> SHR; the location's CRS is from its own source.

inferredPositions.method: Name match to OSM railway=junction label, anchored to the switch on each running line within 3 m of it; topology checked by graph paths.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "ENGLISH BRIDGE JUNCTION"
OSM railway=junction "English Bridge Junction" (node/7479546685), 2-3 m from both anchor switches

Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWBY>SHRWEBJ>SHRWSBJ and SHRWBAF>SHRWEBJ>SHRWSBJ; on the graph, osm-n7177289405 lies on station->Sutton Bridge paths and osm-n2428399162 on Abbey Foregate->Sutton Bridge paths

provenance.note: Position inferred (high confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Name match to OSM railway=junction label, anchored to the switch on each running line within 3 m of it; topology checked by graph paths.

inferredPositions.method: Name match to OSM railway=junction label, anchored to the adjacent switch; topology checked by graph paths.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "SUTTON BRIDGE JUNCTION"
OSM railway=junction "Sutton Bridge Junction" (node/7489901827), 2 m from the anchor switch

Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWSBJ separates DORNGTN (Hereford line) and WELSHPL/WELSWBU (Cambrian line) traffic; the anchor lies on graph paths from the station to both southern boundaries

provenance.note: Position inferred (high confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Name match to OSM railway=junction label, anchored to the adjacent switch; topology checked by graph paths.

inferredPositions.method: Name match to OSM railway=level_crossing "Harlescott Crossing", which is mapped on both running lines.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "HARLESCOTT CROSSING"
OSM level crossings named "Harlescott Crossing" (node/1581276955, node/262539161) are track nodes on the Crewe line
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWBY<>HRLSCTX<>WEMM/YORTON (Crewe line); both anchors lie on graph paths from the station to the northern boundary

SMART (TD area C3) has berth steps at STANOX 64219 HARLESCOT on the Up (8330->8316) and Down (8325->8361) lines, which corroborates a double-track reporting point on the Crewe line; SMART gives no coordinates

provenance.note: Position inferred (high confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Name match to OSM railway=level_crossing "Harlescott Crossing", which is mapped on both running lines.

inferredPositions.method: Timetable role matched to OSM railway=junction "Abbey Foregate Junction"; anchored to the switch on each Wolverhampton-line track ~10 m from it.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC is "SHREWSBURY ABBEY" (CRS XSY), not "Abbey Foregate Junction"; the name does not match directly
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWBAF sits between WELNGTN and SHRWBY, and is where SHRWAFS (Abbey Foregate CS) and the curve to SHRWEBJ diverge
OSM railway=junction "Abbey Foregate Junction" (node/7479546686) is 10 m from both anchors; each anchor lies on a graph path from the station to an eastern boundary track

provenance.note: Position inferred (medium confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Timetable role matched to OSM railway=junction "Abbey Foregate Junction"; anchored to the switch on each Wolverhampton-line track ~10 m from it.

inferredPositions.method: Placed at the switch where graph paths to the Crewe and Chester boundaries diverge, 10 m from the OSM "Crewe Junction" label.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "SHREWSBURY CREWE JN S.B." (names the signal box, not a track point)
OSM railway=junction "Crewe Junction" (node/7479546688) is 10 m from the anchor
All station->northern-boundary and station->north-western-boundary paths diverge at the anchor
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): GOBOWEN>SHRWBCJ>SHRWBY (Chester line)

provenance.note: Position inferred (medium confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Placed at the switch where graph paths to the Crewe and Chester boundaries diverge, 10 m from the OSM "Crewe Junction" label.

inferredPositions.method: Placed at the first switch of the OSM siding way named "Abbey Foregate Yard" on the path from the yard to the main line.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "SHREWSBURY ABBEY FOREGATE CS" (carriage sidings)
OSM siding ways named "Abbey Foregate Yard" (e.g. way/23790018), railway=yard node/10209247164
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWAFS only connects to SHRWBAF (17 starts and 17 terminations)
Which siding the CS refers to is not known; the yard throat is used

provenance.note: Position inferred (medium confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Placed at the first switch of the OSM siding way named "Abbey Foregate Yard" on the path from the yard to the main line.

inferredPositions.method: Topology only: the only siding connection on the Crewe line between Crewe Junction and Harlescott Crossing.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "CREWE BANK R S"
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): HRLSCTX>SHRWBCB>SHRWBY (6 services)
No OSM feature is named Crewe Bank; the former Crewe Bank signal box is reported closed (Wikipedia)

provenance.note: Position inferred (low confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Topology only: the only siding connection on the Crewe line between Crewe Junction and Harlescott Crossing.

inferredPositions.method: Topology only: the main-line connection of the siding group north-west of the station, assumed to be Coton Hill yard.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "COTON HILL T C"
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): COTONH starts/terminates services to and from SHRWBY
No OSM feature is named Coton Hill; the siding group at about 52.717-52.722 N, 2.753 W is the only yard north of the station on that side

provenance.note: Position inferred (low confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Topology only: the main-line connection of the siding group north-west of the station, assumed to be Coton Hill yard.

inferredPositions.method: Same as COTONH: a separate operator's code for the same yard. The specific siding is unknown, so the shared yard connection is used.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "COTON HILL TC GBRF"

inferredPositions.method: Topology only: the first siding switch inside the Coleham depot connection, on the route between the main line and the depot.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "COLEHAM SHUNT NECK"
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRW34>SHRWCSS>COLHLMD (Coleham depot) and COLHLMD>SHRWCSS>SHRWEBJ
OSM landuse "Shrewsbury Coleham Depot" (way/350314924); OSM stop boards (no refs) stand on the sidings between the anchor and the depot

provenance.note: Position inferred (low confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Topology only: the first siding switch inside the Coleham depot connection, on the route between the main line and the depot.

inferredPositions.method: Topology only: the main-line switch giving access to Coleham depot, which both northbound and southbound movements to the shunt neck must use.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "SUTTON BRIDGE JN SIG 15"/"SIG 34" confirm that signals 15 and 34 exist; their positions are not published in any source used
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRW15>SHRW34>SHRWCSS and SHRWSBJ>SHRW34>SHRWCSS
The anchor is the switch where the depot line leaves the main line between English Bridge Jn and Sutton Bridge Jn

provenance.note: Position inferred (low confidence) from OSM geometry and the timetable; not verified. Topology only: the main-line switch giving access to Coleham depot, which both northbound and southbound movements to the shunt neck must use.

inferredPositions.method: Topology only: a track node on the main line between English Bridge Junction and the Coleham depot connection, where an OSM main signal (no ref) stands.
basis: CORPUS NLCDESC "SUTTON BRIDGE JN SIG 15"
Timetable 2026-11-04 (NR SCHEDULE DFROC1F): SHRWEBJ>SHRW15>SHRW34 (4 services)
